about_the_game:
Hordelord Demo is a hi-octane arena mobility shooter (horde & endless modes) where you face waves of nasty enemies. In this demo, you will fight the hordes in two distinct arenas, with different viable tactics and experience. Armed with powerful weapons and high-mobility skills, zip around and fight to achieve the highest score on global leaderboards. Hordelord sports tight gunplay, satisfying kills, and meaningful upgrades.

Features:

  • Horde Mode: Beat a finite number of increasingly difficult waves of enemies.

  • Endless Mode: Try to survive for as long as possible against endless waves of enemies.

  • The demo contains 2 playable arenas, each with distinct gameplay.

  • Get rewarded for your playstyle by performing spectacular kills or hard-to-achieve feats.

  • 6 punchy weapons, each with its own uses, tactics, and upgrades.

  • Unlock powerful alt-attacks for your weapons for even more carnage.

  • Equip Tarot Cards to gain various boosts and synergies to fit your playstyle.

  • Zip around using multi-jump boots, spectral shovel, and various environmental jumpers.

  • Many enemies, each with distinct strengths, weaknesses, and behaviors.

content_descriptors.notes: Hitting enemies causes blood to spill, and particularly powerful attacks can cause them to blow up into gory pieces (limbs).

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.5 Ghz Intel® Core™2 Duo Processor or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 400 series 512 MB video card or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.5 Ghz Intel® i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2 GB video card or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
